exclusions.source_text: Uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to active tuberculosis infection, pneumonitis requiring treatment, symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, or cardiac arrhythmia.
An abnormal screening ECG that, in the investigator's opinion, is clinically meaningful.
Known active hepatitis B (e.g. HBsAg reactive or HBV DNA detected) or hepatitis C (e.g. HCV RNA \[qualitative\] is detected) infection.
Known or suspected presence of another malignancy that could be mistaken for the malignancy under study during disease assessments.
Presence of metastatic disease or recurrent rectal tumor.
